rationale: 识别指标 gmv_gross（约束取数口径）
解析出时间窗口（无时间窗问题由 NL2SQL 决策）

payload.sql: SELECT p.category_l1, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount),2) AS gmv, ROUND(100.0*SUM(o.pay_amount)/(SELECT SUM(pay_amount) FROM fact_order WHERE order_status='paid' AND order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'),2) AS pct FROM fact_order o JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id=o.product_id WHERE o.order_status='paid' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY p.category_l1 ORDER BY gmv DESC
